messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH error rate for inference-prod in az1a (region: us-west-2a). Alerts: 5xx surge, numerous gRPC stream drops. Trigger: latency+error SLO breach. Ticket: PD-2319.

oncall-raj: @here ACK, I'm taking pager. Paging rotation: raj -> sara in 45m. What's the customer impact right now?

maria-sre: seeing ~8% 5xx on recent 1m window for inference-prod endpoints from az1a. p95 token latency up ~220ms (baseline ~60ms). KV cache namespaces show regen churn.

oncall-raj: OK. First mitigation: steer new inference traffic away from az1a to eu-west-1 and us-east-1 replicas, keep sticky sessions for existing KV caches for 5m. Will run routing policy with safe ramp.

infra-bot: Initiating routing policy change: policy-id=reroute-az1a-5987, target-regions=[eu-west-1, us-east-1], ramp=25%/step. Autoscaling: checking capacity in target pools.

sara-eng: @oncall-raj can we warm the KV cache in eu-west before we send significant traffic? cold cache increases token cost even if latency improves. Suggest small warm-up run for top-10 models.

oncall-raj: good call. running warmup -> command: 
```
# warm cache for top models
/opt/tools/runtask --env inference-prod --task warm-kv --models top10 --region eu-west-1
```

maria-sre: logs from proxy (excerpt): 
```
[2026-03-17T10:14:02Z] grpc: stream error: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection reset by peer
[2026-03-17T10:14:05Z] p50=140ms p95=215ms errors=8.3% requests=12.1k
```

ops_lead: Please prepare customer comms. If this persists >30m we need to post to status and pre-emptively notify any enterprise customers with dedicated capacity in az1a. @cust-success follow-up? :warning:

cust-success: I'll draft a short advisory for status with current mitigation steps. Noting potential brief SLO blips for a subset of users routed to az1a. Will flag any dedicated customers (Enterprise-A, FinCorp) and draft targeted emails if degradation continues.

oncall-raj: Executing routing policy now. Step 1: shift 25% of new traffic. Step 2: monitor 2 minutes. If error rate drops, continue to 50%. Action log: `routemgr apply reroute-az1a-5987 --step 1`.

incident-bot: Action completed: routing step 1 applied. Traffic shifted ~24.7% to backup regions. Observability: metrics streaming.

maria-sre: After step 1 (2m): errors down from 8.3% -> 3.1%, p95 down to 140ms. KV cache regen still visible but warming in eu-west-1. Recommend proceed to step 2.

infra-bot: Autoscaler: launched +6 inference-workers in eu-west-1 (g5-like). Warmup tasks in progress.

oncall-raj: Proceeding to step 2 -> shift to 60% new traffic. Leaving 40% as sticky to allow existing connections to drain gracefully.

incident-bot: Action completed: routing step 2 applied. Traffic reroute now ~62% to backup regions.

maria-sre: Metrics update (8m after start): global 5xx now ~1.2%, az1a-only still elevated but serving much less traffic. We'll keep a tighter watch for regressions when clients reattach.

ops_lead: Good work. Next: document timeline and actions for postmortem. Assigning owner for RCA: @maria-sre. Also capture any instance-level network errors and cloud-wide resolver anomalies.

oncall-raj: I'm handing off to @sara-eng for watch and remediation follow-through. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/az-deg-routing.json. Leaving notes in incident channel. Sara — take over at 11:00 UTC.

sara-eng: ACK taking watch. Will monitor for 2h or until error rates stable <0.5% for 30m. If we see reflare, will escalate to cloud provider and consider instance eviction/replace in az1a.

status-bot: Status page updated: Investigating -> Partial degraded performance for inference in us-west-2 (az1a). Mitigation in progress; traffic being rerouted. Next update in 30m or on material change.

cust-success: Posted targeted note to Enterprise-A and FinCorp. Keeping channels open.

maria-sre: leaving initial notes for RCA: potential causes to investigate: NIC driver recv resets, resolver jitter causing proxy timeouts, degraded host disk IO that triggers KV cache thrash. Will pull kernel logs and cloud NIC metrics.

oncall-raj: Closing active pager for now. Team — keep this thread updated with any anomalies. If anyone observes increase -> ping with `!page` to reopen. :thumbsup:
